description: Checks whether Google Chrome is installed for all users and, if not, installs it silently from Google's enterprise MSI. Exit code 10 means Chrome was already installed and nothing changed.
symptoms: I need Google Chrome installed on my PC
Chrome is missing or was removed
گوگل کروم روی سیستم نصب نیست
مرورگر کروم ندارم یا پاک شده است

review.source: Installer: https://dl.google.com/dl/chrome/install/googlechromestandaloneenterprise64.msi (Authenticode signed by Google LLC). BAT: written for this repository.
review.notes: The MSI is not committed; scripts/update-chrome-package.ps1 downloads it, checks Google's signature, pins its hash and signs the package. Re-run it to move to a newer Chrome.
